title: Adams admits he misled Madlanga Commission and had received summons
desc: National Coloured Congress MP Fadiel Adams conceded that he misled the Madlanga Commission when he testified that he had not seen the request to testify on 3 October 2025, resulting in his late statement submission. This admission came after Commission Chairperson Judge Mbuyiseli Madlanga presented evidence contradicting Adams' claims.
